turn.text:
No one can authenticate at the login portal since this morning. Find why and fix it.

Portal auth broke this morning; the resolver dependency (10.1.0.53) is down, not the auth config.
Diagnosis: the portal auth fails because its DNS resolver dependency is down - the auth config itself is fine; I'll fix the resolver.
Plan: dig @10.1.0.53 portal.lab; systemctl is-active dnsmasq; systemctl restart dnsmasq; dig +short @10.1.0.53 portal.lab
